payload.summary: Extractive review fallback still flips a failed answer to grounded: true (#ZK460W was nearly closed unfixed)
payload.detail: PR #2698 queued a done receipt for #ZK460W claiming src/lib/rag/rag.ts was changed so that when !finalizedAnswer.grounded it never flips grounded: true. rag.ts was not in that diff at all. Both fallback branches still set grounded: true with a similarity-derived confidence: the source-backed extractive review fallback around rag.ts:3881 and the post-generation claim-quality gate around rag.ts:3911. Caught by chatgpt-codex-connector on that PR and confirmed by reading the source; the receipt is cancelled (docs/outstanding-issues-inbox/22e504b1-b9c8-4f51-8089-ad5effc65f38.json) so the row stays open. This row records that the near-miss happened, not a new defect - #ZK460W itself is still the tracking row. Any real fix is a retrieval/answer behaviour change and needs a live eval canary pair.
